Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with the following prayers:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. exempt the applicant for appearing before the trial court each and every date in Case No. 9994 of 2010 (State Vs. Sushil Kumar Gupta and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 414 of 2010,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station New Agra,
District Agra, pending before the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra.

3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is resident of Maharashtra and is not in a position to appear before the trial court on each date fixed.

sentences.text: The ends of justice would be served in case applicant is permitted to appear through video conferencing before the court concerned.
4. Learned A.G.A. has not opposed the aforesaid prayer of the applicant.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is hereby provided that the applicant is set at liberty to file an application under the Rules for Video Conferencing for Courts in the State of Uttar Pradesh, 2020 before the court concerned, within a period of thirty days from today.
The court concerned is directed to pass an order permitting the applicant to appear through video conferencing in accordance with law.
However, the court concerned would be at liberty to personally summon the applicant as and when required.
6. With the aforesaid observation/direction, application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.
